description: Pak-Gulf Leasing Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 27 December 1994 as a public limited company and commenced operations on 16 September 1996; the company states that it is principally engaged in the business of leasing/Ijarah and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It provides leasing finance for capital assets, a vehicle finance facility and SECP-approved certificates of investment from its registered office in DHA, Karachi and a branch office in Lahore.
headOffice: UNIBRO HOUSE, Ground Floor, Plot No. 114, 9th East Street, Phase-1, DHA, Karachi-75500, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/V-M.html (Status of the Company), https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/Contact.html, https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/Dir-Sen.html, https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/Leasing.html, https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/VF.html and https://www.pakgulfleasing.com/COI.html (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Leasing / Ijarah finance
products.summary: Leasing finance for capital investment in operating assets, with lease periods and repayment terms structured to the customer's cash flows.

products.name: Vehicle Finance Facility
products.summary: Vehicle financing of up to 90% of the value of the vehicle, for new or used, imported or locally manufactured vehicles, with repayment over a maximum of five years.

products.name: Certificates of Investment (COI)
products.summary: SECP-approved certificates of investment with a preferred minimum investment of Rs 25,000, offered in 12, 24 and 36 month maturities at profit rates the company announces from time to time.
